description: The Letter Train lost its letters! Robo, Duck and Pig find G, H, I, J, K and L, each hiding by a word that starts with it, and check out three look-alike letters that want a ride.

youtube.title: Letters G H I J K L! 🚂 Alphabet Train for Kids | Toy Box Friends
youtube.description:
Toot toot! The Letter Train lost six letters on the bumpy track. Help Robo, Duck and Pig the driver find G, H, I, J, K and L: G by the gift, H by the house, I by the igloo, J up high, K by the kite and L with the lamb. Three look-alike letters try to sneak on board: can you spot them?

Try it at home with a grown-up: make each letter with your body (gallop, hop, stand tall, jump, kick gently, make an L with your hand), then hunt for one thing at home for each letter.

Made for kids. Toy Box Friends: 3D learning videos for preschool.

do.text: Letters G to L
Toot toot! Letters G to L!
Oh no. My letters fell off on the bumpy track!
Six empty cars. We will find them!
We know A to F. Now, G to L!
I will look! Quack!
Wait! Who is this?
I am G! Can I ride?
Is this G? Yes or no?
No! This is C. G has a little shelf.
Not you! Maybe next time, C.
Not you!
Duck, look by the gift!
Found it! Quack!
What letter is this?
It is G! G has a little shelf.
G
G is for gift. G says...
G... gift. G... gallop!
All aboard, G!
Chug-a, chug-a, toot toot! G!
Next, the house!
Peek! Who is behind the house?
What letter is this?
It is H! Two tall lines and a bridge.
H
H is for house. H says...
H... house. H... hop!
All aboard, H!
Chug-a, chug-a, toot toot! G, H!
Next, the igloo!
An igloo is a snow house.
What letter is this?
It is I! I stands tall and straight.
I
I is for igloo. I says...
I... igloo.
Stand up tall like an I!
Some Inuit people built igloos from blocks of snow.
All aboard, I!
Chug-a, chug-a, toot toot! G, H, I!
Where is the next letter?
Up high! On the shelf!
I will jump!
Hmm. Is this J? It looks funny.
It is facing the wrong way!
J, turn around!
Now it is J! A line with a hook.
J
J is for jump. J says...
J... jump!
All aboard, J!
Chug-a, chug-a, toot toot! G, H, I, J!
Whoosh! Look at the kite.
Something is on the string!
What letter is this?
It is K! One tall line and two arms.
K
K is for kite. K says...
K... kite. K... kick!
People have flown kites for more than two thousand years!
All aboard, K!
Chug-a, chug-a, toot toot! G, H, I, J, K!
Hello! I am L! Can I ride?
Is this L? Yes or no?
Baa! L has a foot. This is I.
Not you! Maybe next time, I.
Not you!
Look! L is riding on Sheep!
A baby sheep is called a lamb.
What letter is this?
It is L! A tall line and a foot.
L
L is for lamb. L says...
L... lamb.
Make an L with your thumb and finger!
All aboard, L!
All six letters are on the train!
Chug-a, chug-a, toot toot! G, H, I, J, K, L!
G H I J K L
Gallop, hop, stand tall, jump, kick, make an L!
Ticket check! One. Which letter has a little shelf, G or C?
G! Click!
Two. Which letter is for house?
H! Click!
Three. Which letter has a foot, I or L?
L! Click!
Four. What comes after J?
K! Click! Super ticket checkers!
Toot toot! Bye-bye, G to L!
